# Aavedak

> Aavedak (आवेदक) is a job discovery, application and career platform for junior engineering roles in India. It recommends and prepares; the user decides and sends every application.

Most of the product (jobs, resumes, applications, ATS checks) requires signing in and admin approval, so it is not described here. The public pages are below.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://aavedak.vercel.app/): What Aavedak does and how to get started.
- [About](https://aavedak.vercel.app/about): Who Aavedak is for and how it works.
- [Changelog](https://aavedak.vercel.app/changelog): User-facing release notes.
- [Sign in](https://aavedak.vercel.app/sign-in): Sign in with Google.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://aavedak.vercel.app/privacy): How personal and resume data is handled.
- [Terms of service](https://aavedak.vercel.app/terms): Terms for using Aavedak.

## Crawling and use

- Public pages may be indexed. Pages behind sign-in (dashboard, jobs, resumes, applications, people, admin) are private and should not be crawled.
- Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://aavedak.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
